== Passcode filter on the Devices page

- Filter the device list by passcode support. A new *Passcode* filter, with *Supported* and *Not Supported* values, is available in the device search bar alongside criteria such as Operating System and Audio.
- A device shows as *Supported* when your organization has passcode (PIN) mode turned on and the device has a passcode set.
